title: You Are the Miracle: What Quantum Physics & the Soul Agree On | Gary Zukav’s Personal Experiences
fullTitle: Soul Feast #87: You Are the Miracle: What Quantum Physics & the Soul Agree On | Gary Zukav’s Personal Experiences
description: In this DeepCast, Gary Zukav shares one of the most astonishing realizations of his spiritual journey : that the words he wrote nearly fifty years ago – in his award‑winning book The Dancing Wu Li Masters – described with perfect precision the truth he has since lived, learned, and embodied through decades of experience, love, loss, and guidance from his angelic teacher, Genesis. Drawing on the language of quantum physics,

Gary returns to the physicists’ most profound and paradigm‑shattering conclusion: that what exists is one unbroken wholeness, no aspect of which is separate from any other – and that this is not a theory. It is what you are.

At the heart of this Soul Feast is a question Gary brought to Genesis in frustration and wonder: Why? Why did I have to go through all of that? The decades of searching, suffering, loving, growing, expanding – all of it. And Genesis answered with four words that dissolved every remaining illusion of intellectual accomplishment: So you won’t know it. Not know it as information. Know it as experience. Know it as life itself.
The miracle, Gary reveals, is not something that happens to you. It is what you are. You are the universe – and the universe is love. That is the only reason to do anything at all.
What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

Take out your notebook and sit with what Gary shares in this DeepCast. Think of a moment in your life – something painful, confusing, or hard to understand – and ask yourself: What if this experience wasn’t something that happened to me, but something that happened for me, so that I would know it, not as a concept, but as lived truth? Sit with that. Then ask: in the choices I made today, was I creating from love – from harmony, compassion, and kindness – or from fear? Write down what you notice, without judgment. The miracle isn’t waiting somewhere ahead of you. It is you, here, now, choosing.
